Setup

The HextaUI MCP server gives assistants the same docs you read here: what each component is for, its props and data attributes, keyboard support, working examples and the command that installs it. Assistants stop guessing at shadcn/ui props and use what HextaUI actually ships.
The server also exposes each page as a `hextaui://docs/{slug}` resource, and a `build-ui` prompt that walks an assistant from picking components to installing them.

Windsurf
`get_component_api` returns only the API reference and keyboard support.
`get_component_source` returns the source files the CLI would install.
`get_component` returns a page's full docs: install command, usage, examples, keyboard, accessibility and API reference.
`get_examples` returns the code of any example on a page.
`get_install_command` builds one shadcn command for several components, for npm, pnpm, yarn or bun.
`get_setup` returns the <0>installation</0> guide and the conventions generated code should follow.
`list_components` lists every component, hook and utility by category.
`search_docs` finds components, examples, props and data attributes from plain language, like “confirm before delete” or a prop name.
